jars: Your mind isn't broken. It was never taught to rest
Your phone is where the mind goes to find something to hold onto. But it only finds the next empty thing. See the pattern: the pounce and the drop. Just see it.
When you feel scattered, the senses are the wild horses and the phone is the bit they are chewing.
That small pause is the tortoise pulling in its limbs.
best: Your mind isn't broken. It was never taught to rest, so it keeps running long after you've asked it to stop.
day1_verdict: Okay, so the Gita actually gets that my mind is running away from me, not that I'm just a bad student.
